chunks: From his proofs (peace be upon him): On the Day of Resurrection, when people are gathered barefoot, naked, and dew-clawed, the Imams from the family of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) will stand in the position where God commanded them to stand, and they will say: 'O community of Muslims, indeed God, the Blessed and Exalted, has commanded us to intercede for you, so we will intercede for you.'
ai.seo_question: What is the role of the Imams from the family of Muhammad on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this hadith within the doctrine of *al-Shafa'ah al-Kubra* (the Great Intercession), emphasizing that the Ahl al-Bayt’s authority on the Day of Judgment is not merely honorary but a divinely mandated function of justice. This role underscores the Shia belief in the Imams as the spiritual intermediaries who bridge the gap between the Divine and the creation, ensuring the salvation of the faithful through their unique proximity to God.
